narrative.details:
Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.

Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a hunter.
narrative.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Rockhide Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent, Darlin! You are quite a fast learner.
narrative.requestItemsText: You will learn, Darlin, and one day you will be a great champion.

mentionedItems.name: Taming Rod
tooltip: Use: Begins taming a Rockhide Boar to be your companion for 10 minutes. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail.
